WITH shows_with_slug AS (
          SELECT
            s.id,
            s.name,
            s.slug,
            COALESCE(s.alternative_names, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS alternative_names,
            s.imdb_id,
            s.tmdb_id,
            s.tvdb_id,
            s.tvrage_id,
            s.wikidata_id,
            COALESCE(s.external_ids, $1::jsonb) AS external_ids,
            s.show_total_seasons,
            s.show_total_episodes,
            s.description,
            s.premiere_date,
            COALESCE(s.genres, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS genres,
            COALESCE(s.networks, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS networks,
            COALESCE(s.streaming_providers, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS streaming_providers,
            COALESCE(watch.provider_names, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS watch_providers,
            watch.justwatch_url,
            watch.overview_watch_availability,
            watch.watch_provider_regions,
            COALESCE(s.tags, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS tags,
            s.primary_poster_image_id,
            s.primary_backdrop_image_id,
            s.primary_logo_image_id,
            s.tmdb_status,
            s.tmdb_vote_average,
            s.imdb_rating_value,
            s.created_at,
            s.updated_at,
            
lower(
  trim(
    both $2 FROM regexp_replace(
      regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.name, $3), $4, $5, $6),
      $7,
      $8,
      $9
    )
  )
)
 AS computed_slug,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY 
lower(
  trim(
    both '-' FROM regexp_replace(
      regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.name, ''), '&', ' and ', 'gi'),
      '[^a-z0-9]+',
      '-',
      'gi'
    )
  )
)
) AS slug_collision_count
          FROM core.shows AS s
          LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT
              COALESCE(
                ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT btrim(wp.provider_name) ORDER BY btrim(wp.provider_name))
                  FILTER (WHERE btrim(COALESCE(wp.provider_name, $10)) <> $11),
                ARRAY[]::text[]
              ) AS provider_names,
              MIN(NULLIF(btrim(swp.link), $12)) AS justwatch_url
              ,
              COALESCE(
                (
                  SELECT jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                      $13,
                      grouped.region,
                      $14,
                      grouped.stream,
                      $15,
                      grouped.buy
                    )
                    ORDER BY grouped.sort_order
                  )
                  FROM (
                    SELECT
                      swp_group.region,
                      CASE swp_group.region
                        WHEN $16 THEN $17
                        WHEN $18 THEN $19
                        WHEN $20 THEN $21
                        WHEN $22 THEN $23
                        ELSE $24
                      END AS sort_order,
                      COALESCE(
                        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT btrim(wp_group.provider_name) ORDER BY btrim(wp_group.provider_name))
                          FILTER (
                            WHERE swp_group.offer_type IN ($25, $26)
                              AND btrim(COALESCE(wp_group.provider_name, $27)) <> $28
                          ),
                        ARRAY[]::text[]
                      ) AS stream,
                      COALESCE(
                        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT btrim(wp_group.provider_name) ORDER BY btrim(wp_group.provider_name))
                          FILTER (
                            WHERE swp_group.offer_type IN ($29, $30)
                              AND btrim(COALESCE(wp_group.provider_name, $31)) <> $32
                          ),
                        ARRAY[]::text[]
                      ) AS buy
                    FROM core.show_watch_providers AS swp_group
                    JOIN core.watch_providers AS wp_group ON wp_group.provider_id = swp_group.provider_id
                    WHERE swp_group.show_id = s.id
                      AND swp_group.region IN ($33, $34, $35, $36)
                    GROUP BY swp_group.region
                  ) AS grouped
                ),
                $37::jsonb
              ) AS overview_watch_availability,
              COALESCE(
                (
                  SELECT jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                      $38,
                      grouped.region,
                      $39,
                      grouped.stream,
                      $40,
                      grouped.free,
                      $41,
                      grouped.buy_rent
                    )
                    ORDER BY grouped.sort_order, grouped.region
                  )
                  FROM (
                    SELECT
                      upper(btrim(swp_group.region)) AS region,
                      CASE upper(btrim(swp_group.region))
                        WHEN $42 THEN $43
                        WHEN $44 THEN $45
                        WHEN $46 THEN $47
                        WHEN $48 THEN $49
                        ELSE $50
                      END AS sort_order,
                      COALESCE(
                        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT btrim(wp_group.provider_name) ORDER BY btrim(wp_group.provider_name))
                          FILTER (
                            WHERE swp_group.offer_type IN ($51, $52)
                              AND btrim(COALESCE(wp_group.provider_name, $53)) <> $54
                          ),
                        ARRAY[]::text[]
                      ) AS stream,
                      COALESCE(
                        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT btrim(wp_group.provider_name) ORDER BY btrim(wp_group.provider_name))
                          FILTER (
                            WHERE swp_group.offer_type = $55
                              AND btrim(COALESCE(wp_group.provider_name, $56)) <> $57
                          ),
                        ARRAY[]::text[]
                      ) AS free,
                      COALESCE(
                        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT btrim(wp_group.provider_name) ORDER BY btrim(wp_group.provider_name))
                          FILTER (
                            WHERE swp_group.offer_type IN ($58, $59)
                              AND btrim(COALESCE(wp_group.provider_name, $60)) <> $61
                          ),
                        ARRAY[]::text[]
                      ) AS buy_rent
                    FROM core.show_watch_providers AS swp_group
                    JOIN core.watch_providers AS wp_group ON wp_group.provider_id = swp_group.provider_id
                    WHERE swp_group.show_id = s.id
                      AND btrim(COALESCE(swp_group.region, $62)) <> $63
                    GROUP BY upper(btrim(swp_group.region))
                  ) AS grouped
                ),
                $64::jsonb
              ) AS watch_provider_regions
            FROM core.show_watch_providers AS swp
            JOIN core.watch_providers AS wp ON wp.provider_id = swp.provider_id
            WHERE swp.show_id = s.id
          ) AS watch ON $65
        )
        SELECT
          s.*,
          CASE
            WHEN s.slug_collision_count > $66
              THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(s.slug, $67), s.computed_slug) || $68 || lower(left(s.id::text, $69))
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(s.slug, $70), s.computed_slug)
          END AS canonical_slug,
          poster.hosted_url AS poster_url,
          backdrop.hosted_url AS backdrop_url,
          logo.hosted_url AS logo_url
        FROM shows_with_slug AS s
        LEFT JOIN core.show_images AS poster ON poster.id = s.primary_poster_image_id
        LEFT JOIN core.show_images AS backdrop ON backdrop.id = s.primary_backdrop_image_id
        LEFT JOIN core.show_images AS logo ON logo.id = s.primary_logo_image_id
        WHERE s.id = $71::uuid
        LIMIT $72

query:
select sr.status,
             sr.completed_at,
             coalesce((sr.summary->>$1)::int,$2) as active_jobs,
             coalesce((sr.summary->>$3)::int,$4) as failed_jobs,
             coalesce((sr.summary->>$5)::int,$6) as completed_jobs,
             sj.items_found,
             sj.heartbeat_at,
             sj.metadata->$7 as activity
      from social.scrape_runs sr
      left join social.scrape_jobs sj on sj.run_id = sr.id and sj.job_type=$8
      where sr.id=$9
